create.title: Create

status.active: Live: buyers can see your shop.

details.title: Shop details
details.storyHint: Who you are and how you make it. Up to 600 characters.
details.pickup: Buyers can pick up from me

location.addressHint: Only shown to a buyer after you accept their order.

hours.title: Opening hours
